issues.where: panel b, along the bottom beneath the lamppost and tree
issues.what: The lamp meets the snow almost on the frame edge, and the bottom edge cuts through the right side of the tree’s foot. The close-up shows the trunk but not its complete contact with the ground.
issues.fix: Aim the macro slightly lower so a narrow strip of snow separates both feet from the bottom edge. Keep the close scale and recheck the glass-radius constraint.

issues.where: the sound control at bottom right
issues.what: The speaker icon straddles the pale curved outline of the reflected base, so part of the symbol merges with that outline at phone size.
issues.fix: Move the sound control clear of the reflection edge or give it a small dark backing so the whole glyph stays distinct in every season.
